title: INR to USD today: Rupee rebounds 128 paise from all-time low to 93.57 against U.S. dollar - The Hindu
summary: The rupee depreciated to an all-time low of over 95 against the dollar amidst the West Asia conflict, with oil prices and FII outflows contributing to the decline. Despite this, the Finance Minister asserts that India's economic fundamentals remain strong and the rupee is performing fine compared to other emerging market currencies.
sentiment_reason: The rupee's depreciation, influenced by external factors such as oil prices and FII outflows, coupled with political references to past statements, has led to negative market sentiment despite the Finance Minister's assurance of strong economic fundamentals.
